handoff_instructions: M2-T25 done. Migration 0015_retention.sql adds per-org organizations.webhook_payload_retention_days (default 30) and communication_retention_days (default 365), plus webhook_receipts.payload_purged_at as an idempotency marker. New packages/core/src/services/retention.ts has the two purge queries (purgeExpiredWebhookPayloads, purgeExpiredCommunications): each joins organizations for its own window, only selects terminal-successful rows (webhook status processed/ignored; communication status completed/failed/abandoned), and clears payload / transcript+summary+structured_extraction while leaving identity, disposition, participants and all events/audit untouched. New packages/workflows/src/retention-purge.ts (purgeExpiredRetention, RETENTION_WORKER actor) runs both and writes one business_events + audit_log entry per organization actually touched (new EVENT_TYPES.webhookPayloadsPurged/communicationsPurged); wired into runBackgroundJobs (packages/workflows/src/jobs.ts) so it runs on the existing job schedule. Organization gained webhookPayloadRetentionDays/communicationRetentionDays on the domain type and toOrganization mapping. Tests: packages/core/test/retention.test.ts (purge behavior: window, terminal-status-only, per-org windows, idempotency, identity kept) and packages/workflows/test/retention.test.ts (event/audit trail written only for organizations with something purged, none on a no-op rerun). docs/PRODUCTION_HARDENING.md retention row updated to Done. format/lint/typecheck/test all pass. Next: M2-T26 (M2 automated acceptance suite) once this is reviewed.
